pages.en:
CONFIDENTIAL.
C. I. D.
F. O. REG
No. 676
Date. 31/10/16
Shanghai Municipal Council.
October 31st 1916.

（印：SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL COUNCIL POLICE FORCE）
POLICE FORCE,
(DETECTIVE BRANCH)

Sir,
In connection with the attached there were no developments to report. The workmen engaged left as scheduled on October 8th. Some twenty out of the 500 did not turn up and only 480 went in the end.
I have been informed, confidentially, that the French Government have not obtained by a long way all the men they desire to have. They need 50,000 in all.
As far as Shanghai district is concerned it is thought that when the 480 workmen who left last reach their destination they will write to their friends here and that their letters will have a good effect and aid the agents here in gathering in new recruits.
Further recruiting is to be left in abeyance in the meantime.

Your Obedient Servant,
mmuunmuuStuuu
Chief Detective Inspector.

Chief Detective Inspector.

机密。
刑事侦缉处。
外侨登记处
第 676 号
日期：1916年10月31日
上海工部局。
1916年10月31日。

（印：上海工部局警务处）
警务处，
（侦探股）

先生：
关于附件所述事项，并无新进展可报。受雇工人已按计划于10月8日离沪。500名工人中约有20人未现身，最终仅有480人成行。
我已私下获悉，法国政府招募的人数远未达到其期望之数额。他们总共需要50,000人。
就上海地区而言，人们认为，当上述480名工人抵达目的地后，将会写信给此地的朋友，这些信件将产生良好影响，并协助此地的代理人招募新员工。
与此同时，进一步的招募工作暂缓进行。

您忠实的仆人，
mmuunmuuStuuu
总探长。

总探长。

pages.en:
H.B.M. Consulate-General
Shanghai
30th September, 1916

CONFIDENTIAL.

My dear McEuen,

My French Colleague has sent me copy of his
reply to an impudent letter from Mr. Yang Ch'eng
who sent him a protest from the notorious pro-Ger-
man Yü Ya-ching against the engaging of Chinese
workmen for service in France. They are to leave
on 6th October.

Mr. Magiar would be grateful if you would
take precautions against probable attempts by Yü
and the Germans to get up an agitation amongst the
Ningpo workmen with whom he may have influence.

I am
Yours sincerely

（批：Cpt.
Keep in close touch with them
here & prevent if possible their
being 'got at'. Report any
developments. It is a pity there is
such a delay.）

K.J. McEuen Esquire
Captain-Superintendent of Police
SHANGHAI.

英国驻上海总领事馆
上海
1916年9月30日

机密。

亲爱的麦克尤恩（McEuen）：

我的法国同事向我发送了他回复杨诚（Yang Ch'eng，音译）一封无礼信函的副本，该信是代表臭名昭著的亲德分子虞洽卿（Yü Ya-ching）提出的抗议，反对招募中国工人赴法服役。这些工人将于10月6日启程。

马贾尔（Magiar，音译）先生将感激您采取预防措施，防止虞洽卿及德国人可能试图在与其有影响力的宁波工人中煽动骚乱。

您真诚的

（批注：上尉。
与此地人员保持密切联系，
并尽可能防止他们被“拉拢”。
报告任何进展。
如此延误实属遗憾。）

致 K.J. 麦克尤恩（K.J. McEuen）先生
警务处总监
上海
